literal: Towards sulking I went indeed, O friend! That having forgotten, towards union went my heart.
translation: O friend! I went with the intention of sulking, but my heart, completely forgetting that resolve, rushed towards union.
modern: தோழியே! நான் அவரிடம் ஊடல் கொள்ளவே சென்றேன்; ஆனால், என் நெஞ்சம் அதை மறந்துவிட்டு அவரோடு கூடுவதற்குச் சென்றுவிட்டது.
explanation: The heroine shares her helplessness with her companion after meeting her lover. She had firmly resolved to show feigned anger (ஊடல்) to prolong the sweet pleasure of reconciliation. However, the moment she saw him, her heart completely forgot that intention and rushed to embrace him. The contrast between 'ஊடற்கண்' (towards sulking) and 'கூடற்கண்' (towards union) highlights the conflict between her conscious mind and her uncontrollable feelings. Ultimately, her heart acted independently of her will, surrendering to love.
